reason: The math works: three free meetings, a EUR 900 ceiling I can sign myself, and I approve the list and every first message, so my downside is capped. I'd take the free 15-company sample first and only start the pilot if those companies are ones my sales team would actually want.
objection: Our name is on those emails. One badly worded cold message to a German or Polish buyer we want long term, or a GDPR complaint, costs more than EUR 900. And one logistics case study tells me nothing about manufacturers.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies were generic or ones we already know, or if they won't put the GDPR responsibility split and the 48-hour rejection rule in the contract, I walk away.
